name: AI Resource Sift
description: Given one AI topic, it trawls papers, repositories, lectures, courses, Reddit threads and lab documentation, then filters the haul into a sizeable reading stack with a brief card summarising it in chat. Suits early groundwork on an unfamiliar area; less use for a narrow factual question.

official.title: AI Resource Sift by Alen
official.description: For one AI topic, sweep papers, code, lectures, courses, Reddit, and official lab docs, then keep a large filtered stack. Short card in chat, full stack...
